mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have overcast skies and 76 degrees at Badger Ridge Middle School. The moon phase is a Waning Crescent. Tonight, look for the space station to pass over at 9:05 PM, rising above Mount Horeb and moving toward the East Northeast. The overnight low will be 62 degrees with no rain expected.

In city news, the Verona Police Department announced the arrest of 34-year-old Halla Nelson of Madison. The investigation concerns an inappropriate relationship between a teacher and a student that occurred during the summer or fall of 2019, which was reported to the department on August 30, 2026.

For upcoming events, you can attend yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, there are several trivia options including events at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and the Bogey Factory. Looking further ahead, Paddy Mac's will host live music on September 9, alongside the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market.
Regarding the weekly report, the Verona Police Department arrested Halla Nelson on Friday, September 4, 2026, in connection with an incident reported on Sunday, August 30, 2026.
Today's flavor of the day is Georgia Peach. The restaurant is currently open and will remain so until 10 PM this evening, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
